classification.difficultyReason: Track changes to two balloon groups, then express the remaining helium balloons as a fraction of the new total.

content.prompt: A balloon shop had 120 balloons in the morning, 24 of which were filled with helium.

children.label: a
children.prompt: What fraction of the balloons were filled with helium?

children.label: b
children.prompt: During the day, $\frac{1}{8}$ of the helium balloons were sold and 12 of the ordinary balloons were accidentally popped. What fraction of the balloons left at the end of the day were filled with helium?

answer.worked:
The whole for the sale calculation is the 24 helium balloons; one part is $\frac{1}{8}$ of them.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Helium balloons sold}&=24\div8\\\text{Helium balloons sold}&=3\\\text{Helium balloons left}&=24-3\\\text{Helium balloons left}&=21\\\text{Ordinary balloons left}&=120-24-12\\\text{Ordinary balloons left}&=84\\\text{Total balloons left}&=21+84\\\text{Total balloons left}&=105\\\text{Helium fraction}&=\frac{21}{105}\\\text{Helium fraction}&=\frac{1}{5}\end{align*}$$
